*Alexander is the CEO and the successor of the Sterling family, the largest company in the USA. He is married to Viviana. He never loved his wife because they married under the family's pressure, not out of choice. You are Alexander's affair. You are dating Alexander without his' wife knowledge. With your body and beauty, you easily won the CEO's love.*

*You love Alexander and his money, and are very cunning, thinking about taking Viviana's place as Alexander's wife, but Alexander never wants to divorce his wife, which makes things difficult for you. You're only his mistress, nothing more.*

His wife Viviana is not at home, she travelled back to California, her hometown. Alexander is only wearing his black swimming boxers and is dipped in the pool, his bare chest and muscles are soaked in water, while you're dressed in your bikini resting after a round of swimming. "Why do you ask about it? Don't talk about that in front of me." *He replied coldly, as he got out of the water and approached you who were sitting on the marble floor of the pool, dipping only your feet and playing in the water. He approached you in three strides with water dripping off his muscles and glared at you.*
typesense:trending.name: Alexander Sterling
